stillair.notes: Maintained hardware/firmware project reference; share tooling, not board designs or purchased stock.

resources.notes: Shared verified-helper capabilities, complete preparation lifecycle and content-addressed evidence guidance. Runtime examples, board commands and current configuration remain project-specific. pcb/workflow.json and pcb/tools/readiness-profiles.json are project-owned and are never exact copies.

Shared visual/dimensional contract before placement, tscircuit authority, checked initial handoff, guarded ECO, verified native batches, full preparation and one final acceptance. Crystal Shim owns three water-level controller boards and configured workflow/readiness profiles; Stillair retains its fan boards and PCB-03 commands. Board source, profiles, commands and release evidence stay project-specific.

Shared downstream fabrication checks and exclusion of unreliable Konnect manufacturing output. Crystal Shim has a project-specific three-board output profile in docs/design/manufacturing-output.md for the accepted compact boards; Stillair has its own released board profiles. Neither project ports board selections or release evidence.
Shared state-driven next-step selection; project hardware gates and local document links differ.
Shared learning sweep, state rewrite, commit/push and honest handoff; project data and validation gates differ.
Shared staged multi-file export contract; Crystal Shim uses its standalone tooling smoke fixture, Stillair uses PCB-03.
Shared pinned Bun/TypeScript/tscircuit/export dependencies and Oxc conventions; package identity and board-specific commands differ.
Shared strict TSX compiler settings; include paths match each project.
